subject: history

items.q: Was Mao's Great Leap Forward an economic success?
items.correct: No — it caused a catastrophic famine in which millions died.
items.misconception: Yes, it rapidly modernised China successfully.
items.random_wrong: It had no effect on China.
items.why: Unrealistic targets and policies led to mass famine (1958–62).

items.q: What did the Cultural Revolution do?
items.correct: Caused chaos, persecution and the closure of schools and universities.
items.why: Red Guards attacked 'old' culture and perceived enemies, causing widespread upheaval.
